cards.text: A man who calls himself the elder is writing a letter to the chosen lady and her children. He loves them in the truth, and he's not the only one. Everybody who knows the truth loves them too!

cards.question: The elder says the truth that abides in us will only stay with us for a season.
Next, the elder writes that grace, mercy and peace will be with us in truth and love. Along with God the Father, who does he say they come from?

answers.text: Jesus Christ the Son of the Father
The apostles who lead the church
The angels who stand in heaven

cards.text: The elder found some of the lady's children living just the way the Father commanded, and he wasn't just happy. He was OVERJOYED, like me when a whole batch comes out and NOTHING is burnt!

cards.question: What did the elder find some of the chosen lady's children doing that made him so happy?

cards.text: Then the elder turns to the dear lady and urges her to keep a commandment. Not a tip, not a suggestion, friend, a COMMANDMENT!

cards.question: Which commandment does the elder urge the dear lady to keep?

answers.text: That we rest on the Sabbath

cards.question: The elder calls the commandment to love one another a brand new commandment.
Next, the elder explains what love is. He says love means walking according to His commandments.

cards.text: And the commandment they've heard from the beginning? That they must walk in love.
Then the elder's tone changes, friend. He says many deceivers have gone out into the world.

cards.question: What do the deceivers the elder warns about refuse to confess?

answers.text: The coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh
The creation of the heavens and earth
The words of the prophets of old

cards.text: The elder doesn't soften it one bit. Anyone like that, he calls the deceiver and the antichrist.
Then the elder gives a warning: watch yourselves. Friend, when a letter says that, you put the mixing spoon DOWN and pay attention!

cards.question: The elder tells the chosen lady and her children to watch themselves so they don't lose what's been worked for. Instead, he wants them to be fully ___.

cards.text: He says anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Friend, I once pulled a batch out before the timer went off, and running ahead NEVER ends well!

cards.question: The elder says whoever remains in the teaching of Christ has the Father but not the Son.

cards.text: Now he gets practical. What if someone comes to them but doesn't bring this teaching?

cards.question: If someone comes to the chosen lady without the teaching of Christ, what does the elder tell her to do?

answers.text: Not welcome him in or even greet him
Give him a bed for one night only
Bring him before the church to be tested

cards.question: The elder says anyone who greets a person who comes without the teaching of Christ shares in his evil deeds.

cards.text: The elder has many things to write, but he'd rather not do it with paper and ink. Friend, I spent YEARS buried under paper in the back of a junk drawer, so I am WITH this man!

cards.question: Instead of writing more to the chosen lady with paper and ink, what does the elder hope to do?

answers.text: Come and speak with them face to face
Send a trusted messenger in his place
Keep praying for them from far away

cards.question: The elder hopes to come and speak face to face, as he puts it, "so that our ___ may be complete."

cards.text: The letter closes with greetings from the children of the lady's elect sister. Everybody wants a hello in this letter, friend!
